name: rook
description: Hand web work, files and bash to Rook, the browser agent in your own Chrome profiles.

interface.shortDescription: Hand web work to the browser agent in your Chrome
interface.longDescription: Rook is a browser agent in your own Chrome, signed in as you. This plugin's rook-browser skill drives it through the rook CLI: sites behind your login, pages that need a real browser, Playwright code, a page's WebMCP tools, and files in Rook's workspace. It needs Google Chrome with the Rook extension and Node.js 22.18 or later.
defaultPrompt: Ask Rook to open the team wiki and list next week's on-call rotation
